description: Secondary-flow magnitude comparison: B2's already-converged uncorrected kOmegaSST RANS baseline vs the benchmark's own shipped DNS reference field (U_LES), for AR_1_Ret_360 and AR_3_Ret_360.
leakage_note: No new CFD, no fitting/tuning/selection against test-case ground truth. Pure post-processing of already-existing forward RANS solves against the benchmark's own shipped DNS reference.
verdict: GATE MEASURED, FAIL AS EXPECTED. Linear eddy-viscosity kOmegaSST predicts exactly zero secondary flow (machine precision) in both cases; DNS shows 2.07-2.22% of bulk velocity. Documented, literature-consistent structural limitation of the Boussinesq hypothesis, not a setup error -- directly explains the AR_1_Ret_360/AR_3_Ret_360 deficit contribution.
blocked: AR_14_Ret_180 baseline not yet reproduced by this campaign (case files available, not run this rung)
Spatial secondary-flow vortex-pattern comparison not attempted (bulk RMS magnitude only)
